name: Pinneberg (Germany)
description: White field with narrow red stripes along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the city arms of Pinneberg (a white castle between stars above a green mount with a wavy bar on red).
history: The arms and the flag were approved on 25 November 1960; the flag shows the city arms in a white field bordered above and below by a narrow red edge.

features.role: Pinneberg arms — castle, stars and mount on red
